notes.content:
Story Updates not available!

Gameplay Additions:

Added main menu
Added save and load functionality
Added language options
Gameplay Changes:

Lightning intervals are now completely random
Thunder occurs randomly afterward
Lightning now has random brightness levels
Atmosphere is even denser and darker
Thunder delay increased (Previously 5-20 seconds, Now 7-20 seconds)
Lens flares slightly reduced
Film grain made slightly more pleasant
Flashlight light has some movement
Shadow issues fixed
Gameplay Fixes:

Game no longer hangs on non-single events
Removed "Hello Test" from triggers
No more significant lag when saving (switched to async)
